build_json.what: hCA II (PDB 6RL9, chain A) with the sulfonamidate anion of sulfanilamide on the zinc, crystal water, TIP3P water and NaCl in a truncated octahedron
build_json.status_note: REHEARSAL of 6 Oct 2026, not a result for the paper. Parameter set 2e (MCPB.py step 2e, empirical zinc constants; RESP charges with the equal ligand atoms made equal) with the terms at N2 as built BEFORE gate G-R: they are not validated. Built to test the pipeline (md/test/REHEARSAL_2e.md) and for a first look at the bonded site.
build_json.units: Angstrom, degrees, e, amu, kcal mol-1 (Amber parameters); nm and kJ mol-1 nm-2 only where the key says so
build_json.random_numbers: none; the ion sites follow a fixed rule (ions.rule) and tleap places nothing by chance

force_field.gaff2_version_line: AMBER General Force Field for organic molecules (Version 2.2.30, Oct 2025)
force_field.water: TIP3P (rigid; the topology holds the H-H bond)
force_field.ligand: as delivered by MCPB.py (charges of the zinc site refitted; see mcpb)
force_field.zinc: bonded to its four nitrogen atoms with the terms of MCPB.py (see mcpb, zinc_site_bonded)

zinc_line_of_frcmod.line: Zn2+  1.271  0.00330286    CM set for TIP3P water from Li et al., JCTC, 2013, 9, 2733

force_field.sodium_chloride: Joung-Cheatham for TIP3P (frcmod.ionsjc_tip3p, loaded by leaprc.water.tip3p)
notes: frcmod.ions1lm_126_tip3p of CA2_tleap.in is not loaded: Na+ and Cl- keep the parameters of leaprc.water.tip3p (Joung-Cheatham), as in the restrained model

mcpb.bond_commands_used: the four to the zinc; the peptide bonds of the renamed residues are made by loadpdb through head and tail atoms set on their units (see leap.in)

terms_at_N2.source: written by the builder: the terms AS BUILT BEFORE GATE G-R (Zn-N2-S, S-N2-H and H-N2-S-C4 as in the frcmod of MCPB.py; Zn-N2-H at its angle in start X with the force constant of that frcmod)
terms_at_N2.replaced_line_of_mcpb_frcmod: M1-Y4-hn    50.00     120.00    Created by empirical method using MCPB.py
lines_copied_from_mcpb_frcmod: M1-Y4-sy    50.00     117.55    Created by empirical method using MCPB.py
hn-Y4-sy    61.550     118.059       theta0 was 111.270; force constant GAFF2
ca-sy-Y4-hn    1     0.2624      180.0  -1.0      rotation about S-N, fitted to DFT single points; replaces the term by analogy
terms_at_N2.file: n2_terms.frcmod (in build/ of the system and in md/topology)
terms_at_N2.loaded: after every parameter file of MCPB.py, so its terms are the ones in force

pairs_across_the_zinc.rule: Amber: atoms one or two bonds apart do not interact (excluded); atoms three bonds apart interact with the electrostatics divided by 1.2 and the Lennard-Jones term by 2.0 (1-4); atoms four or more bonds apart interact in full. Checked here for every pair whose bonds run through the zinc
pairs_across_the_zinc.zinc_to_sulfonyl_oxygens: three bonds apart (Zn-N2-S-O): a 1-4 pair, scaled as above

against_the_restrained_system_of_this_st.note: each pair is [this system, the restrained system]

repaired_terms.expected_from: n2_terms.frcmod, which is loaded after the repair frcmod and MCPB.py's frcmod
n2_terms.frcmod, which is loaded after the repair frcmod and MCPB.py's frcmod

box.shape: truncated octahedron (tleap solvateOct; triclinic cell with three equal edges)
tleap_solvation_lines: Scaling up box by a factor of 1.188589 to meet diagonal cut criterion
Total bounding box for atom centers:  96.149 96.149 96.149
box.note: as built the box is larger than it will be at 1 bar (see density_as_built); 'any orientation' is the cell edge minus the largest extent of the solute, a lower bound for a rigid solute

ions.rule: pairs = round(c * N_water / c_water) with c = 0.15 mol/L, c_water = 55.3 mol/L (water at 300 K) and N_water the water molecules after solvateOct (crystal water included): the concentration in the volume of the solvent. Then one Na+ per negative charge of the solute.

placement.rule: each ion replaces one water molecule added by solvateOct, never a crystal water: candidates are the added molecules whose O is at least 6.0 A from every atom of protein, zinc, ligand and crystal water; they are ordered by sha256('cqc-sfa-md ion sites|<seed>|<k>') (k = place among the added molecules, from 0) and taken in that order if at least 6.0 A (minimum image) from every site already taken; the kinds alternate Na+, Cl- in the order taken
placement.why_not_tleap: addIonsRand has no seed (its help text: the result differs between invocations) and may replace a crystal water; addIons puts every ion on the protein surface

charge_not_zero: The unperturbed charge of the unit (-1.000000) is not zero.
The unperturbed charge of the unit (-1.000000) is not zero.

water_at_the_site.note: positions of the crystal ligand: the 11 heavy atoms of SAN 304; a water molecule there in start R means that solvateOct filled the place the rotated ligand leaves empty

geometry_as_built.frame: fitted on the CA atoms of reference.pdb, as md/analysis/SPEC.md does

protocol.read_by: md/run_md.py; the reasons for each value are in md/RUN.md
protocol.units: stated in every key name (nm, ps, fs, ns, K, bar, amu, kJ mol-1). Every harmonic term is U = 0.5 k d^2.

force_field.source: all parameters are read from system.prmtop of the built system; the driver changes none of them
force_field.planned_in_md_PLAN_section_3: protein ff14SB, water TIP3P, 0.15 M NaCl, ligand GAFF2 with repaired terms at sulfur, zinc site bonded (MCPB.py) or, as fallback, restrained
force_field.added_by_the_driver: the harmonic bonds of extra_forces.json (none for the bonded model), position restraints during minimisation and equilibration, the barostat

system.hydrogen_mass_repartitioning: applied when the OpenMM System is created (createSystem, hydrogenMass): every hydrogen bonded to a heavy atom gets this mass and the heavy atom loses the difference, so the total mass is unchanged; the hydrogens of rigid water keep 1.008 amu

position_restraints.energy: U = 0.5 * k * d^2 per restrained atom; d is the distance from the reference position (minimum image)
position_restraints.reference_positions: the coordinates of system.inpcrd (crystal or docked heavy-atom positions)

atom_sets.solute_heavy: heavy atoms of the protein (selections.json protein_heavy), the zinc (zn) and the ligand (lig_heavy)
atom_sets.solute_heavy_and_crystal_water_O: solute_heavy plus the oxygens of the crystal water, if selections.json lists them under the optional key crystal_water_O
atom_sets.protein_backbone: the atoms named N, CA, C and O among protein_heavy

minimisation.max_iterations_meaning: per pass: OpenMM's minimiser repeats L-BFGS with stiffer terms for the constrained bonds until they are satisfied; the passes and their iteration counts are recorded

equilibration.initial_velocities: Maxwell-Boltzmann at the first temperature of stage 1, from the run seed

hydration_check.added: 6 Oct 2026; md/PLAN.md, entries of 6 Oct 2026, 1:03 AM IST (point 3), 3:02 AM IST (point 8) and 8:01 AM IST (point 7: the six ring carbons only, without N1)
hydration_check.purpose: the rotated start has no water where the ring of the crystal pose lies; an empty place beside the ligand could draw the ring back and make a conversion look easier than it is
hydration_check.when: at the end of the stage after_stage, the last one in which the heavy atoms of the solute are held, and again at the end of every extension step; on the coordinates that the step saves
hydration_check.site_positions: the coordinates of these ligand atoms in reference.pdb of the built system (the crystal pose, for every start), carried into the frame of the current coordinates by the least-squares fit of the protein CA atoms (selections.json protein_CA against the CA atoms of reference.pdb in file order; no weights)
hydration_check.count: the water oxygens (selections.json water_O) at most water_cutoff_nm from any of the site positions, each counted once; minimum-image distances
hydration_check.applies: only if the ligand's own site atoms (selections.json lig_heavy, same names) are on average farther than this from the site positions; otherwise the ligand itself is at the site, the check is skipped and the count is only recorded
hydration_check.rule: if the check applies and the count is zero, the held part is extended by one extension step and the count is made again, at most max_extensions times; after that the run goes on in any case and no water is placed by hand
hydration_check.extension_steps: named eq<after_stage>x<n> (eq03x1 to eq03x4); the settings of the stage after_stage (ensemble, time step, temperature, restraints) with the length above; ordinary steps with their own record, files and seeds (the step tag in the seed rule is the name of the step); --equil-scale shortens them like the stages; they add up to 2000 ps to total_ps
hydration_check.recorded_in: rec_<step>.json of the stage and of every extension step (key hydration_check: the count, the waters, the distances of the ligand from the site, the decision and the next step) and manifest.json (key hydration_check: all counts, the number of extension steps, the final decision)

stages.name: heat
stages.temperature_ramp: linear, raised once per ps, 300 K in the last ps

production.time_zero: the end of the equilibration; frame k of a run is at k times the frame interval

output.trajectory_format: DCD (CHARMM layout, little-endian, single precision, Angstrom, unit cell in every frame)
output.solute_frames: the atoms of selections.json solute (protein, zinc, ligand), as integrated, never wrapped into the cell
output.full_frames: all atoms; the solute as in the solute frames, every water molecule and ion moved by cell vectors to the image nearest to the centre of the solute

seeds.run_seed: --seed, or the first 4 bytes of sha256('cqc-sfa-md run seed|<run-id>') reduced to 1..2147483646
seeds.step_seed: the first 4 bytes of sha256('cqc-sfa-md step seed|<run seed>|<step tag>|<purpose>') reduced to 1..2147483646; purpose is velocities, integrator or barostat; the step tag is eq01..eq06 or seg0001..
